mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., SPX returns positive >55% of periods when both series decline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 370,000 indicates strong demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 370,000.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rising above 216.0 signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 216.0.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction (HOUST) declining below 1000.0 indicates housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1000.0.
